name: Unlabelled-Pre-Adapted Vision-Language Transformer MIL
summary: Patient tile bags from aligned vision-language pathology encoders (CONCH-Z and MUSK) are mapped via a learned linear projection into a multi-head Transformer aggregator. Strictly inside each training fold, the aggregator is pre-adapted using patient sub-bag consistency across training-fold and 259 unlabelled patients before balanced supervised fine-tuning with inner-selected flat or hierarchical subtype heads. Performance is evaluated via 3x5 repeated nested patient-level cross-validation and 5-fold site-held-out cross-validation against null and patient-mean logistic baselines. This determines standalone H&E PAM50 predictability, site robustness, and gain over simple mean pooling.
preprocessing: Exclude all clinical, immunohistochemistry receptor (er, pr, her2), histological_type, age, stage, RNA-derived, and site features from model inputs; retain site solely to define site-held-out CV splits
Pool all slides and aligned tiles per patient (1,132 slides into 1,061 patient bags: 802 labelled, 259 unlabelled) so every patient stays strictly on one side of all CV and bootstrap splits

Inside each training fold only, concatenate aligned CONCH-Z (768-d) and MUSK (1024-d) tile vectors (1,792-d) and fit per-feature z-score scaling on training-fold labelled plus 259 unlabelled tiles, applying frozen parameters to held-out fold tiles

Verify majority-class null, stratified class-prior null, and inner-tuned single-encoder patient-mean balanced logistic reference on identical 802 labelled patients and outer fold assignments while excluding all 259 unlabelled patients from scoring

training.convergence_rule: Verify non-increasing trailing-5-epoch SSL sub-bag loss slope and stabilised supervised training loss / inner-fold validation macro-F1 before termination in every fold
training.tie_break_rule: If inner-fold macro-F1 candidates lie within one inner-fold standard error, select the lower-capacity 1-layer 128-dim flat-head setting

metrics: Out-of-fold four-class macro-F1 with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference above majority-class and stratified class-prior null floors with 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference versus inner-tuned single-encoder patient-mean balanced logistic regression reference with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Proportion of class-prior multi-class log-loss (Shannon entropy) explained out-of-fold with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Macro and per-class one-vs-rest AUROC across LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2 with 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs
Per-class recall, precision, and F1 across LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2 with 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs
Site-held-out 5-fold grouped cross-validation macro-F1 and paired gain over chance across 19 collection sites with 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs
Per-fold SSL sub-bag consistency loss and supervised training loss / inner-validation macro-F1 convergence trajectories
allowed_conclusions: Select strictly among the four pre-specified predictability conclusions (Broad, Partial, Site-confounded, or Insufficient evidence) from the 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs over chance in repeated nested patient CV, per-class F1, and 19-site grouped CV; claim an advantage for semi-supervised Transformer MIL over simple mean pooling only if its paired macro-F1 95% CI vs patient_mean_logreg lies strictly above zero, scoped strictly to standalone H&E prediction in TCGA-BRCA.
rationale: Sub-bag self-supervision across training and 259 unlabelled patients regularises high-capacity Transformer tile interaction against small-n/large-p overfitting (D3) and variable multi-slide bag sizes (D6). Learned vision-language projection, balanced weighting, and inner-tuned hierarchical heads preserve minority Her2 and LumA-versus-LumB signals (D1, D9), while site-held-out CV audits confounding (D4).
